body.statement: For every \(m\geq1\) and \(K\geq2\), if \(C\sim C'\), then \(C'=C\) or \(C'=C^\top\). More precisely, after Proposition 1 fixes \(r\), the legal symmetric switch \(D_{r-e_a-e_b}+E_{ab}+E_{ba}\) implies \((h_a-g_a)(h_b-g_b)=(h'_a-g'_a)(h'_b-g'_b)\) for every distinct supported \(a,b\), and hence the two arm-imbalance vectors agree up to a common sign.
body.justification: The switch identity turns an exponential family of nuisance schedules into an arm-imbalance outer product, reducing the classification to the survival of transposition.
body.gap: Generic orbit theory in \cite{HemerikGoeman2018} starts from invariance; it does not provide the causal zero-sum switches that force this two-point reduction.
body.consumer: It converts any future implementation of equivalence checking from comparison over all profiles to tests of a profile and its arm transpose.
